cylinder_hopf.description: 2D cylinder wake - Hopf bifurcation (Re=50, just above critical Re_c≈46.6)

checks.name: growth_rate
checks.description: Leading eigenvalue real part (growth rate) should be positive (unstable)

cylinder_hopf.notes: Reference: AMR paper Table 1, Barkley & Henderson (1996)

backstep_tg.notes: Reference: Blackburn et al. (2008), Barkley et al. (2002)

thermosyphon_pitchfork.description: Thermosyphon - Stability at Ra=400 (below critical Ra_c1≈494)

checks.name: stable_below_critical
checks.description: Leading eigenvalue should be negative (stable, Ra < Ra_c)

checks.name: pitchfork_type
checks.description: Leading eigenvalue should be real (pitchfork mode)

thermosyphon_pitchfork.notes: Reference: AMR paper, pitchfork bifurcation at Ra_c1≈494. At Ra=400 flow is stable.

flipflop_ns.description: Side-by-side cylinders - Floquet at Re=60 (below critical Re_c2≈61.17)

checks.name: floquet_magnitude
checks.description: Leading Floquet multiplier magnitude |μ| < 1 (stable, Re < Re_c)

flipflop_ns.notes: Reference: Carini et al. (2015), Neimark-Sacker at Re_c2≈61.17. At Re=60 flow is stable.

tpjet_pd.description: Forced jet - Period-doubling at Re=1900 (above critical Re_c≈1371)
tpjet_pd.notes: Reference: AMR paper, period-doubling at Re_c≈1371. At Re=1900 flow is unstable.
